meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `devs.adaptyvbio.com` or `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交蛋白序列做结合与稳定性实验,自动取回表征结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在跑蛋白结合或稳定性实验,想批量提交序列并拿回结果
copy.tagline_en: Submit protein sequences for binding and stability assays, then fetch the results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run protein binding or stability experiments and want to submit sequences in bulk

howto.what: Claude 会用 Adaptyv Bio Foundry 的 API 和 Python SDK 帮你查找靶点、估算费用、提交蛋白序列做结合或热稳定性等检测，并在约 21 天后取回实验结果。
howto.when: 当你提到 Adaptyv、Foundry API、BLI/SPR 检测等，或想提交蛋白序列做实验表征时触发；代码里导入 adaptyv、FoundryClient 也会触发。

say.text: 帮我在 Adaptyv 上查 EGFR 靶点，并估算一次 BLI 筛选的费用
say.note: 会列出匹配靶点并返回费用估算

say.text: 把这几条序列建成 screening 实验，先存成草稿不要提交
say.note: 实验会以 Draft 状态创建

say.text: 查一下那个实验现在什么状态，Done 了就取回结果
say.note: 返回当前状态，Done 时附上结果

howto.what_en: Claude gains the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK: it can find targets, estimate cost, submit protein sequences for binding, thermostability and expression assays, and retrieve results (~21 days).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Adaptyv, Foundry API or BLI/SPR assays, want to submit protein sequences for characterization, or when code imports adaptyv, adaptyv_sdk or FoundryClient.

say_en.text: Find the EGFR target in Adaptyv and estimate a BLI screening run's cost
say_en.note: Lists matching targets and returns a cost estimate

say_en.text: Create a screening experiment with these sequences, keep it as a draft
say_en.note: Creates the experiment in Draft status

say_en.text: Check that experiment's status and fetch the results if it's Done
